7.4.3.2.1 Enable NvM Proxy Generation
[SWS_SwCluC_02101] ⌈The NvM High Proxy code, and related AUTOSAR model
descriptions, shall only be created, if the configuration parameter SwCluCProxyGen-
erationNvM is set to HIGH_PROXY.⌋(SRS_SwCluC_00206, SRS_SwCluC_00204)
[SWS_SwCluC_02144] ⌈The NvM Low Proxy code, and related AUTOSAR model de-
scriptions, shall only be created, if the configuration parameter SwCluCProxyGener-
ationNvM is set to LOW_PROXY.⌋(SRS_SwCluC_00206, SRS_SwCluC_00204)
caption: 7.4.3.2.1 Enable NvM Proxy Generation
